item.title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial

exact_text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer.

item.tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

answer_sheet.Platform and size: Vertical 9:16 for a social reel; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Presenter: A fictional woman in her thirties, filming herself at home; not a real customer.
answer_sheet.Script and captions: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
answer_sheet.Language, voice and mood: English, friendly and casual; specific accent is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished square social media advertisement for FitTrack, an app that helps people plan their workouts. Modern premium fitness brand design, dark navy background with vibrant lime-green accents, crisp white typography, excellent legibility, generous negative space. Main visual on the right: a realistic sleek smartphone showing a beautifully designed generic workout planning interface with a weekly calendar and simple strength and cardio workout cards, beside a neatly placed dumbbell. Abstract subtle motion lines, professional studio lighting. On the left include these exact words with clear typographic hierarchy: brand name 'FitTrack' at top; large bold headline 'Your goals.\nYour workout plan.'; smaller supporting copy 'Plan your workouts. Stay focused.'; prominent lime-green rounded CTA button 'Plan your next workout'. Render all text accurately and legibly. Do not add other text, prices, performance claims, reviews, download store badges, logos of other companies, or invented features. Cohesive professional advertising layout, mobile-feed readable.
